source.title: More Starshells
source.description: We still need more Starshells to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Seradane and bring me back some.
source.objective: Gather 10 Starshells in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Thank you. Your services will be remembered.
